svg.title: Prompt-enhanced multi-expert fine-tuning and multi-expert advantage RL diagram
svg.desc: Full editable SVG reconstruction. Base frames include left input column, prompt-enhanced fine-tuning section, multi-expert RL section, expert-output dashed groups, image input dashed group, and right loss/objective groups. Construction proceeds from left input origin toward base/policy model and then through outputs, rewards, estimation, advantages, and objectives. Confirmed SAM assets are used only after visible native construction for icons, output-card stacks, GT model, Python icon, and first image crop.

rect.desc: Input column frame: title, expert prompt boxes, instruction box, image dashed box.

line.desc: Vertical dashed boundary between input and method diagram.

rect.desc: Prompt-enhanced multi-expert fine-tuning frame, separated below by dashed horizontal guide.
Multi-expert advantage RL frame with policy model, output groups, reward, estimation module, advantage groups, and objectives.
Dashed Images frame containing three mechanical-view drawings; left subimage is covered by SAM P012.
Top vertical output logits frame containing O1, On, ON cards.

g.desc: Origin at Input title; contents proceed downward: two expert prompt boxes, instruction box, and dashed image frame.
Two vertical rounded model blocks form the central spine immediately right of the input separator. A large orange downward weights arrow connects Base Model to Policy Model.
Origin is the Base Model block. Moving right: output O stack, L_MEF loss, CoT answer stack, Python icon above, and expert icons on the right. Section uses horizontal symmetry along y≈153.
Three confirmed expert icons mapped to SAM assets P001, P006, and P002 after draft construction.

Origin is Policy Model. Contents conduct rightward: expert output groups, reward model and estimation module, GT model below, relative advantage groups, and three objectives on the right. Arrangement has three-row vertical equipartition for experts 1, n, N.
